description: Skill entity field mapping with file upload support
notes: ✨ This is for AgentSkill (entity), not AgentSkillRelation (relationship)
Contains complete skill data including metadata, configuration, and business fields
- agid, skid: Belong in AgentSkillRelation (relationship table)
Cloud SkillInput/SkillUpdateInput excludes owner, flowgram, langgraph, status, created_at, updated_at, and ext
Schema fields: askid, name, description, version, level, config, diagram, tags, examples, inputModes, outputModes, apps, limitations, path, source, price, price_model, public, rentable
source field: Comma-separated list of relative file paths under the skill directory. Cloud returns presigned URLs for uploading these files.
